historical_commentary.text: This note is a charming artifact of 1990s computing — auto-dialing a telephone via a Hayes-compatible modem using serial port commands from a database application. The SET CHANNEL and SEND PACKET commands used here for serial communication have been deprecated in modern 4D. The entire concept of modem-based telephone dialing from a desktop database is obsolete in the age of VoIP, smartphones, and cloud telephony APIs. Nevertheless, it illustrates how 4D's serial communication commands enabled creative hardware integration.
